# orch8_api_key (Resource)

A tenant API key (`/api-keys`). Requires the provider to use the engine's root API key. Keys are immutable: any change revokes and re-mints. Destroy revokes the key (`DELETE /api-keys/{id}`); a key revoked out of band disappears from state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires the provider to authenticate with the engine's root API key.
resource "orch8_api_key" "workers" {
  name         = "gpu-workers"
  capabilities = ["worker"]
}

output "worker_key" {
  value     = orch8_api_key.workers.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `capabilities` (Set of String) Any of `operator`, `worker`, `device`, `publisher`, `approver`, `auditor`. The engine defaults to `["operator"]`.
- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC 3339 expiry.
- `name` (String) Human-readable label.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant the key is bound to. Defaults to the provider's tenant_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Key id.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The key secret. Only returned at creation (null after import).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by "<tenant_id>/<key_id>". The secret cannot be recovered after import.
terraform import orch8_api_key.workers acme/key_0194d2e6
```
